caption: The drawing depicts a disassembled view of a small accordion or concertina. The instrument is shown with its major components separated: the left side features a rectangular wooden panel with a cream-colored frame and two round metal discs, as well as two metal levers. The center section consists of the bellows, which are light in color and patterned with small pink and green floral motifs. The right side displays another rectangular wooden panel, decorated with gold floral inlay, and a series of white round buttons arranged in two columns, each button attached to a short lever. Below the main group is a separate, smaller component that appears to be another wooden section, similar in design to the right panel, with more white buttons and gold inlay, set at an angle. The background is a plain, off-white color, providing contrast to the instrument's brown and cream tones, along with the light pastel colors of the bellows.
title: Woman's Accordian
